area-alt: The tool could not confirm whether the image map area has a meaningful alternative text. Verify that each clickable area has alt text that describes its destination or purpose, not just its appearance.
aria-allowed-attr: The tool detected an ARIA attribute that may not be valid for this element's role, but could not make a definitive determination. Confirm that all ARIA attributes are appropriate for the element's assigned role.
aria-braille-equivalent: The tool could not verify whether the braille label has a meaningful non-braille equivalent. Confirm that any aria-braillelabel or aria-brailleroledescription has a corresponding aria-label or aria-roledescription that conveys the same meaning.
aria-command-name: The tool could not determine whether this button, link, or menu item has an accessible name in all contexts. Test with a screen reader to confirm the control is announced with a meaningful label.
aria-hidden-focus: The tool detected a potentially focusable element inside an aria-hidden container but could not confirm the focus behavior. Test keyboard navigation to ensure no focus lands inside hidden regions.
aria-input-field-name: The tool could not confirm the accessible name of this ARIA input field. Test with a screen reader to verify the field is announced with a clear, descriptive label when focused.
aria-meter-name: The tool could not determine whether this meter element has an accessible name. Test with a screen reader to confirm the meter's purpose and current value are announced meaningfully.
aria-progressbar-name: The tool could not confirm whether this progress bar has an accessible name. Test with a screen reader to verify the element is announced with a label that identifies what is being tracked.
aria-prohibited-attr: The tool detected an ARIA attribute that may be prohibited for this element's role but could not make a definitive determination. Review the element's role and remove any ARIA attributes that conflict with it.
aria-required-children: The tool detected a parent ARIA role that may be missing required child roles, but could not confirm this due to dynamic content. Inspect the rendered DOM to verify required child roles are present.
aria-toggle-field-name: The tool could not confirm the accessible name of this toggle field. Test with a screen reader to ensure checkboxes, radio buttons, and switches are announced with descriptive labels.
aria-tooltip-name: The tool could not confirm whether this tooltip has an accessible name. Test with a screen reader to verify the tooltip content is announced and meaningful in context.
aria-valid-attr-value: The tool detected an ARIA attribute with a potentially invalid value but could not make a definitive determination. Verify each ARIA attribute value matches the expected type and references valid IDs where applicable.
bypass: The tool could not confirm whether a functional skip link or landmark structure is in place. Test keyboard navigation to verify users can bypass repeated navigation and jump directly to main content.
button-name: The tool could not determine whether this button has a discernible accessible name in all rendering contexts. Test with a screen reader to confirm the button's purpose is announced when focused.
color-contrast: The tool could not calculate the contrast ratio because the element's background is dynamic, transparent, or covered by another element. Check the rendered color values manually using a contrast checker.
color-contrast-enhanced: Background color could not be determined for AAA contrast evaluation. Verify manually using a contrast tool against the actual rendered colors.
duplicate-id-aria: The tool detected a duplicate ID used in an ARIA attribute or label but could not confirm the full impact. Verify that all IDs referenced by aria-labelledby, aria-describedby, and for attributes are unique on the page.
form-field-multiple-labels: The tool detected a form field that may have multiple labels, which can confuse screen readers. Confirm that each field has exactly one clear, programmatically associated label.
frame-focusable-content: The tool could not confirm whether focusable content inside this frame is reachable by keyboard. Test keyboard navigation to verify that tabindex=-1 is not blocking access to interactive elements inside the frame.
frame-title: The iframe must be tested directly with assistive technology to verify its accessible name is meaningful in context.
frame-title-unique: The tool could not confirm whether all iframes have unique titles. Verify that each iframe has a title attribute that distinguishes it from others on the page and describes its content.
image-alt: The tool could not determine whether the image's alternative text is appropriate. Review the alt text in context — it should convey the image's meaning, not describe its appearance, and decorative images should have empty alt attributes.
input-button-name: The tool could not confirm whether this input button has a discernible accessible name. Test with a screen reader to verify the button's value or label is announced correctly.
input-image-alt: The tool could not confirm whether this image input has adequate alternative text. Verify that the alt attribute describes the button's action, not the image itself.
label: Some form labels could not be verified programmatically. Confirm each input has a visible, associated label that is meaningful when read aloud.
link-in-text-block: The tool could not confirm whether this link is visually distinguishable from surrounding text without relying on color alone. Check that links within body text have an additional visual indicator such as underline, weight, or border.
link-name: The tool could not confirm whether this link has a discernible accessible name in all contexts. Test with a screen reader to verify the link's destination or purpose is announced clearly.
nested-interactive: The tool detected potentially nested interactive controls but could not confirm the behavior. Test keyboard navigation and screen reader output to ensure nested controls do not cause focus or announcement issues.
no-autoplay-audio: The tool could not confirm whether autoplaying audio exceeds 3 seconds or has a stop/mute mechanism. Manually verify that any audio starting automatically can be paused or muted within 3 seconds.
object-alt: The tool could not confirm whether this object element has meaningful alternative text. Verify that the element contains fallback text or a text alternative that conveys its content or function.
role-img-alt: The tool could not confirm the accessible name of this element with role='img'. Test with a screen reader to verify the element's purpose is announced, or add an aria-label or aria-labelledby.
select-name: The tool could not confirm whether this select element has an accessible name. Test with a screen reader to verify the dropdown is announced with a descriptive label when focused.
server-side-image-map: The tool detected a server-side image map, which cannot be navigated by keyboard or assistive technology. Verify whether this can be replaced with a client-side image map or equivalent accessible navigation.
summary-name: The tool could not confirm whether this summary element has a discernible accessible name. Test with a screen reader to verify the disclosure widget label is meaningful and announces the expanded/collapsed state.
svg-img-alt: The tool could not confirm whether this SVG has adequate accessible text. Verify that SVGs used as images have either a title element, aria-label, or aria-labelledby that conveys their meaning.
td-headers-attr: The tool could not confirm whether the headers attribute correctly associates data cells with their headers. Inspect the table structure and verify each td's headers attribute references the correct th IDs.
th-has-data-cells: The tool could not confirm whether all table header cells have associated data cells. Review the table structure to ensure each th describes actual data and is not orphaned.
empty-heading: The tool detected a heading that may be empty or contain only whitespace or non-text content. Verify that all headings contain meaningful visible text.
aria-dialog-name: The tool could not confirm whether this dialog or alertdialog has an accessible name. Test with a screen reader to verify the dialog's purpose is announced when it opens.
aria-text: The tool could not confirm whether role='text' is used correctly on an element with no focusable descendants. Verify the element contains only static text and that the role is not masking interactive content.
aria-treeitem-name: The tool could not confirm whether this tree item has an accessible name. Test with a screen reader to verify each item in the tree is announced with a meaningful label.
frame-tested: The iframe could not be tested by axe-core because it is cross-origin or otherwise inaccessible to the tool. Run axe-core directly on the iframe's source page or test it manually with a screen reader.
identical-links-same-purpose: The tool detected links with identical visible text that may point to different destinations. Verify that links sharing the same label either go to the same destination or have additional context such as aria-label or aria-describedby to differentiate them.
skip-link: The tool detected a skip link but could not confirm it navigates to a focusable target. Activate the skip link with a keyboard and verify focus moves to the intended main content area.
